basics.name: Ivan Gegov
basics.label: AI Systems Builder · Agent Orchestration · RAG & Automation
basics.summary: AI systems builder who designs, ships, and operates multi-agent fleets, orchestration and control planes, long-term memory and retrieval systems, source-grounded research knowledge bases, and full-stack AI web products. Work spans editorial AI publishing, evidence-graded research pipelines, a paper-only multi-agent finance desk, real-time fleet dashboards, and interactive 3D web — combining provider-aware LLM workflows, RAG with citations and provenance, structured evaluation, batch extraction pipelines, local-model tooling, and production-minded delivery across Windows, VPS, Oracle, GCP, Vercel, and private model infrastructure.

work.name: Independent
work.summary: Self-directed engineering and operations across agentic software, retrieval, research pipelines, automation, interactive web products, and the infrastructure that keeps them observable and safe.
highlights: Built and operates a multi-agent development fleet (Hermes/Dispatch) with shared project contracts, task routing, evidence receipts, and a live control dashboard.
Designed source-backed memory and retrieval systems that preserve raw events, expose searchable recall, and keep citations and provenance attached to answers.
Built multi-corpus research ingestion pipelines with batch claim-extraction (Anthropic Message Batches + OpenAI-compatible providers), evidence tiering, and provenance graphs.
Implemented provider-aware workflows across Claude managed agents, Claude Code, OpenAI-compatible APIs, OpenRouter, Ollama/local routers, and deterministic fallbacks.
Operates delivery across Vercel, VPS/Oracle, KVM2, Caddy, systemd, Docker/Compose, GCP Secret Manager, n8n, GitHub Actions, Tailscale, and Windows Task Scheduler.

projects.name: The Drop
projects.description: Editorial AI publication with a daily morning edition and a weekly history/interpretability series — research, editorial review, structured publication data, ElevenLabs-narrated audio, multi-language (EN + Bulgarian), and subscriber delivery via web and Telegram.

projects.name: Lore Keeper
projects.description: Source-grounded continuity knowledge base over a novel trilogy — an LLM answers questions about characters, events, locations, timelines, and contradictions with citations down to chapter, backed by a compiled world graph.

projects.name: MoneyWolf
projects.description: Paper-only, read-only multi-agent finance desk turning provider receipts, risk decisions, and local books into source-backed projections — with a hard no-real-orders boundary.

projects.name: SD Forest / Forest HUB
projects.description: Living project atlas and AI/web product environment — static web atlas plus FastAPI/SQLite services hosting reference tools, AI/LLM indexes, interactive Three.js experiences, and fleet views.

projects.name: Steady Steps (growing-up-os)
projects.description: Evidence-graded parenting-guidance web app over a research corpus — surfaces cited claims with study design, effect sizes, source quotes, and honest caveats, and separates validated clinical interventions from weaker-evidence approaches.

projects.name: Research Ingestion Pipeline
projects.description: Multi-corpus claim-extraction and knowledge-base pipeline — ingests papers and documents into chunked, cited, evidence-tiered claims with provenance triples and embeddings, running batch jobs through the Anthropic Message Batches API and OpenAI-compatible providers across domains (parenting, ADHD, strength science, and more).

projects.name: Glass Mem
projects.description: Long-term agent memory and evidence pipeline — append-only raw event capture, searchable recall, and citations attached to the source event (lexical FTS5 + vector retrieval).

projects.name: Glass PR Solver
projects.description: Evidence-first GitHub PR operations system that drains a backlog through independent gather / decide / review / act stages, with explicit abstain/unknown/failure states and honest CI evidence.

projects.name: Hermes / Dispatch Fleet
projects.description: Multi-agent runtime and dispatch operation built on the Hermes-Agent harness — specialist agents, task ledgers, scheduled ingest, evidence-bearing handoffs, and a mobile dispatch surface that routes work to isolated coding sessions.

projects.name: Fleet / Dispatch Dashboard
projects.description: Real-time local control surface for the fleet — aggregates current workstreams, decisions, sessions, project-health probes, verification state, research items, and expiring-credit horizons from a shared JSON board; persistent service with phone access over Tailscale.

projects.name: Fleet Automation Spine
projects.description: n8n workflow backbone on a self-hosted node wiring the dashboard → n8n → managed-agent loop — scheduled ingest, approval gates, and publishing automation for the fleet's recurring jobs.

projects.name: Chloé Council & Voice Assistant
projects.description: Private multi-agent decision surface (typed PWA/gateway, four live agent positions, server-side synthesis, model-router preflight) plus a proactive voice assistant wired to the fleet with local/low-cost TTS.

projects.name: HypertrophyOS
projects.description: Strength- and hypertrophy-science knowledge base built from peer-reviewed papers — extracted, cited, and query-able claims for evidence-based training guidance.

projects.name: Kids Library
projects.description: Curated children's film and book library with original AI-generated artwork and honest parent guidance — theme/age filtering, country-aware streaming availability, and poster-to-IMDb linking, built as original art rather than reproduced posters.

projects.name: AI Control Plane · SDForest Contribution Gateway · repo-shelf
projects.description: A provider-neutral operational control plane joining agent contracts, hooks, project snapshots and review gates; a human-in-the-loop FastAPI research-ingestion gateway; and an interactive 3D repository catalogue (React Three Fiber).
